assumptions.choice: Entry and exit signals use explicit crossover threshold conditions: 'falls below 30' / 'crosses below 30' is defined as rsi_m1[-1] >= 30 and rsi_m1[0] < 30; 'rises above 70' / 'crosses above 70' is defined as rsi_m1[-1] <= 70 and rsi_m1[0] > 70.
assumptions.reason: Ensures precise event-driven entry/exit triggers and prevents immediate re-entry on consecutive bars when RSI remains in overbought/oversold territory.

assumptions.choice: Inspects self.datas for additional timeframe feeds (M5 as datas[1], M15 as datas[2]) to compute RSI(21) if provided by Cerebro. If only a single 1m feed is provided by the harness, M5 and M15 indicators are safely omitted.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader Strategy instances cannot dynamically attach resampled data feeds to Cerebro during strategy execution.
